title: A Controlled Experimental Evaluation of Configuration and Cache Architecture in LLM Serving Engines
abstract: arXiv:2611.05991v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-agent LLM applications repeat most of their prompt tokens across requests, and serving engines reuse the cached state of shared prefixes. vLLM and SGLang reuse it at different granularities, and benchmarks of their default deployments report large performance gaps, usually credited to the cache. Such comparisons rarely control for other configuration differences. One of them, whether a long prompt is prefilled in chunks, is set by each engine's defaults from the hardware and the release, and it confounds the comparison. We built a reproducible testbed on Kubernetes and a seeded multi-agent workload generator, and compared the two engines under vendor defaults and with chunked prefill matched. SGLang's configuration is the same in both arms, which makes it an internal control across independently provisioned deployments. translated_title: LLM 服务引擎中配置与缓存架构的受控实验评估
translated_abstract: 多智能体 LLM 应用在多个请求之间重复使用大部分提示词 token，服务引擎会复用共享前缀的缓存状态。vLLM 和 SGLang 以不同的粒度实现复用，针对两者默认部署的基准测试报告了巨大的性能差距，通常将其归因于缓存。然而这类比较很少控制其他配置差异。其中一个差异是长提示词是否采用分块预填充，该设置由各引擎根据硬件和版本的默认值决定，从而混淆了比较结果。我们在 Kubernetes 上构建了一个可复现的测试平台和一个带种子的多智能体负载生成器，在厂商默认设置和分块预填充对齐两种条件下对两个引擎进行了比较。SGLang 的配置在两组实验中保持一致，这使其成为跨独立部署环境之间的内部对照。在默认设置下，vLLM 的中位首 token 延迟最高可达 SGLang 的 64 倍。仅对齐这一项设置即可消除 78% 的差距。
tldr: 该研究通过受控实验发现，vLLM 与 SGLang 服务引擎之间的巨大性能差距主要源于分块预填充的默认配置差异而非缓存架构本身，仅对齐这一配置即可消除大部分差距。
en_tdlr: Through controlled experiments, this paper shows that the large performance gap between vLLM and SGLang serving engines stems mainly from differing chunked prefill defaults rather than cache architecture, and matching this single setting removes most of the gap.
